findings.title: Hard routing deadline
findings.root_cause: Blocking response reads and unbounded single-flight/spacing waits.
findings.verification: Real local HTTP and 0.8-second benchmark pass; one exchange for four waiters; all workers reaped.
findings.remaining_limitation: Bounded termination/response overhead follows the network budget; latest local measurements 13-26 ms. Single flight is per process.

findings.title: Original route geometry
findings.root_cause: Two-mile downsampling removed original corners; nearest sampled neighbors missed valid segments.
findings.verification: 0.848-mile station retained within 1 mile; marker and all-segment prefilter comparisons pass.
findings.remaining_limitation: City-point positions and local straight-line projection remain approximations.

findings.title: Offline US boundary validation
findings.root_cause: Nearest Census place within 25 miles both admitted foreign cities and rejected remote US land.
findings.verification: Windsor/Tijuana rejected; Yellowstone, Alaska, Hawaii, Aleutians and US-side border cities accepted. Real API returns 422 for foreign coordinates.
findings.remaining_limitation: Census 1:500,000 land polygons are generalized; survey precision, offshore water and territories are outside scope.

findings.title: Complete plan configuration key
findings.root_cause: Plan key omitted MPG/range and other computation settings.
findings.verification: 10-to-20 MPG recomputes; live restart yields $153.28 vs $306.55, then valid plan hit; zero upstream calls from cached geometry. GUI checked at both configurations.
findings.remaining_limitation: Calculation and boundary versions must be bumped when their semantics/data change.

findings.title: Cross-process station freshness
findings.root_cause: Process-global index was never checked against committed database updates.
findings.verification: Separate observer refreshes 1 to 6620 stations; rollback ABA and coherent snapshot regressions pass.
findings.remaining_limitation: Raw SQL must bump revision in the same transaction. Requests already using an old committed snapshot may finish with it.

findings.title: Complete station fingerprint
findings.root_cause: Fingerprint omitted metadata that affects output and highway-confidence eligibility.
findings.verification: Every StationRecord field independently invalidates fingerprint; renamed/address-changed output and confidence eligibility recompute.
findings.remaining_limitation: New output/eligibility fields must be added to the snapshot when introduced.

findings.title: Read timeout status mapping
findings.root_cause: Requests wraps urllib3 read timeouts in ConnectionError, previously treated as connection failure.
findings.verification: Real stalled body and wrapped read timeout return 504; real connection refusal remains 503; Newman fault checks pass.

findings.title: Truthful fill explanation

8_explanation.reason: Filled the tank: no cheaper station is reachable within range, and the next stop, B (Testville, TX) at mile 700, costs more ($3.100 vs $3.000/gal).

findings.root_cause: Explanation inferred global reachability from the chosen next stop, ignoring detour tradeoffs.
findings.verification: Reachable cheaper station 265 miles away is skipped for total detour cost; optimal $151 result unchanged and wording accurate.
findings.remaining_limitation: Explanation describes the price/detour decision without attributing a numeric marginal cost to each skipped station.

findings.title: Malformed JSON and extreme coordinates
findings.root_cause: Unchecked response shape/keys and overflowing float conversion escaped domain validation.
findings.verification: Invalid JSON/shapes/metadata return controlled 503; huge/nonfinite/bool/malformed coordinate inputs return 400; no 500.

findings.title: Accurate Loom narration
findings.root_cause: Script claimed no request-time geocoding and disallowed an empty tank although both were valid behaviors.
findings.verification: Tracked script and original external copy corrected: free text can geocode; fuel may reach zero but never be negative. Prices/test counts updated.
findings.remaining_limitation: Live provider distances and derived prices can change; refresh demonstration numbers before recording.
